blocks.text: ANGELES CITY, PAMPANGA, Philippines — Do young people know what a volcanic eruption is? Can they imagine the destructive force of lahar? Beyond the altered landscapes, what other tragedies did communities endure from a disaster whose effects are still felt today? Answers to these and other questions about the June 15, 1991, eruption of Mt. Pinatubo, the years of lahar flows and the disaster that followed are now just a few taps away. Young people can access this information through the Pinatubo Kiosk, an interactive digital booth that is the newest feature of the Center for Kapampangan Studies (CKS) Pinatubo Museum […]...
